_comment: Single source of truth for the tribunal-seat / dashboard / template model IDs. The drift gate (scripts/check-model-ids.py, audit-gates Gate 134) fails the build if any governed file references a token in `stale` or any claude-* id not in `current`'s values. Update `current` here (and regenerate the dashboards + copilot package) when a model is superseded; move the retired id into `stale`. See CLAUDE.md milestone 'Canonical model catalog + drift gate'.
_context_windows_comment: context_windows keys are the same aliases as `current` (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable), values are each model's real context-window ceiling in tokens. As of the 2026-10-17 playbook, every current pin including Haiku 5.5 is 1,000,000. An unresolved haiku-shaped id (for example the retired dated Haiku 4.5 pin) still falls back to a 200,000 heuristic in scripts/context-usage-meter.py so an older Haiku session is not told it has a 1,000,000 window. See CLAUDE.md milestone 'Context-usage meter becomes model-aware'.

freshness_notes.pins_2026-10-17: current pins follow the 2026-10-17 Claude API playbook (Opus 5.5 claude-opus-5-5, Sonnet 5.5 claude-sonnet-5-5, Haiku 5.5 claude-haiku-5-5, Fable 5.1 claude-fable-5-1). This session did not re-fetch the live alias table. Opus 5.5 defaults effort to medium, so set effort explicitly. Fable 5.1 is the quality-escalation pin only after Opus at xhigh demonstrably fails; do not pin legacy claude-fable-5 (same sticker price, 4x cache-read price, no per-message effort). The model-fallback ladder may still list Fable as an outage retry; that is not the quality-escalation rule.
